sources.title: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF: Lightweight Open-Source LLM
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-.5B-Instruct-GGUF Qwen2.5-.5B-Instruct-GGUF is a 490M-parameter instruction-tuned language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, quantized in GGUF format for efficient local deployment. It supports up to 32,768 token context and 8,192 token generation, covers 29 languages, and is optimized for coding, math, and structured data tasks.

sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.
